query:
-- Sample the users with openId but no email to understand what they are
SELECT id, openId, name, email, loginMethod, createdAt, lastSignedIn, waitlistStatus
FROM users
WHERE openId IS NOT NULL AND email IS NULL
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Check how many have a waitlistStatus set (real waitlist signups)
SELECT waitlistStatus, COUNT(*) as count
FROM users
WHERE openId IS NOT NULL AND email IS NULL
GROUP BY waitlistStatus;
